title: Workflow foreach/atom fan-out lacks per-child task/session/output capture (ensemble has it)
wanted_capability: A declarative foreach primitive that captures each dynamic-N fan-out child's {task_id, session_id, invocation_id} AND its retrievable output into the collected results — parity with ensemble nodes, which already build per-member member_tasks/member_sessions + output maps (src/workflow/engine/ensemble_nodes.rs:76-108) and a terminal actor→session_id map (engine.rs:79). Today foreach.collect gathers only a child-exported var, with no per-child dispatch-id capture; and atom_invoke children return a content-addressed output_digest + output_shape via atom_status (NOT inline output), so a downstream synthesis/sieve node receives neither reliable provenance nor the actual payload. Either foreach should expose ensemble-style per-child provenance, or there needs to be an inline atom-output retrieval (deref the output_digest) usable in workflow context.
missing_primitive: foreach per-child {task_id,session_id,invocation_id}+output capture (ensemble-parity), or atom output_digest deref in workflow vars
fallback_used: v1 used an actor-node foreach whose inline ${Node.output} the foreach could export (worked, but no output-schema enforcement); v2 switched to atom_invoke for schema enforcement and LOST inline output → empty sieve, provenance=0. Pathology workflows avoid this by using a whiteboard as the fan-out→synthesis data bus.
evidence: arc-efbbea05600e44f48317aed9ef9d5a39 produced empty sieve; atom_status returned output_digest sha256 + output_shape{schema_ref:outputs.schema,valid} with no inline output
resolution_note: Foreach/matrix item results now carry full per-child provenance AND payload (verified + completed 2026-07-14, beta/blackbox-v2). Since filing, the fanout collector already grew {index, key, item, status, exports, outputs (all child node outputs), arc_id, arc_thread_id, error}; this change adds the last missing piece: actor_sessions (the child arc's terminal actor→session map, ensemble-parity) on every collected item (src/workflow/engine/fanout.rs, FanoutChildOutcome). The atom half of the gap is also stale: atom_invoke returns inline "data" alongside output_digest/output_shape, and run_atom_node records the full atom_status JSON into actor_results + node output. Docs: reference-implementations.md § foreach documents the real collected-entry shape (the old {item, result, status} description was stale). Regression: workflow_foreach_runtime_collects_child_exports asserts arc_id + actor_sessions on collected items.
